description: Reference COBOL→.NET-8 scaffold pair. Targets the COBOL claim taxonomy (invariants / section contracts / I/O side effects / edge cases / open questions) and produces a buildable .NET 8 package that mirrors the Fortran→.NET 8 scaffold one-for-one — proving the platform is target-stack agnostic across legacy languages.

matches.fallback: Default cobol→dotnet8 archetype while per-section matcher (#3c.next) is still in development.

platformReadiness: Schema + prompt + .NET 8 archetype ship in-tree (this directory). Engineer flow: ingest a COBOL corpus → extract spec via cobol→dotnet8 prompt → SME signs → scaffold lands as a Demo.RollStock.csproj package with claim-mapped sections.
